request: Order ORD-1001 hasn't shipped yet. Investigate why and what we should do.

steps.text: I will look up the order details to confirm its status, items, warehouse, and promised delivery date so I can decide whether to check inventory or shipments next.
I will check on-hand and available stock for each ordered SKU at the fulfillment warehouse (WH-BOS) to determine if an inventory shortage is preventing shipment.
I will search other warehouses for SKU-202 to see if a single location can cover the shortfall of 38 units for a transfer.

arguments.summary: ORD-1001 has not shipped because WH-BOS does not have enough stock of SKU-202 (12 available vs 50 ordered). WH-CHI can fully cover the 38-unit shortfall, so an immediate stock transfer is recommended to protect the 2026-03-17 ship-by date.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1001 fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT; fulfillment_warehouse_id WH-BOS; ship_by_date 2026-03-17; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-19; items include SKU-202 quantity 50
check_inventory: SKU-202 at WH-BOS on_hand 12, reserved 0, available 12 (ordered 50)

find_alternative_stock: SKU-202 required_quantity 38 (shortfall); WH-CHI available 80 can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-ATL available 30 can_cover_required_quantity false; WH-DAL available 0 can_cover_required_quantity false
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient available stock at WH-BOS for SKU-202 (12 available vs 50 ordered), preventing shipment.

recommended_actions.details: Create an inter-warehouse transfer of 38 units of SKU-202 from WH-CHI to WH-BOS to cover the shortfall; justified by find_alternative_stock showing WH-CHI available 80 and can_cover_required_quantity true for 38, and check_inventory showing WH-BOS available 12 vs 50 ordered. Aim to have the transfer in time for the ship-by date 2026-03-17.
Ship the 12 units currently available at WH-BOS now, and fulfill the remaining 38 units once the transfer arrives; justified by check_inventory: WH-BOS available 12 for SKU-202 (ordered 50).

Inform Northwind Retail that the order will be split or may be delayed while sourcing 38 additional units; reference promised_delivery_date 2026-03-19 from get_order_details and advise that the remaining units are being transferred from WH-CHI (find_alternative_stock).

arguments.recommendation: Transfer 38 units of SKU-202 from WH-CHI and ship the 12 available units now, notifying the customer about the split/transfer to protect the 2026-03-19 delivery commitment.
